comment:
* This class helps to handle CRL revocation reasons mask. Each CRL handles a
 * certain set of revocation reasons.

variables.name: allReasons
variables.comment: * A mask with all revocation reasons.

methods.name: void addReasons(ReasonsMask mask)
methods.comment:
* Adds all reasons from the reasons mask to this mask.
     * 
     * @param mask The reasons mask to add.

methods.name: boolean isAllReasons()
methods.comment: * Returns true if this reasons mask contains all possible * reasons. * * @return true if this reasons mask contains all possible * reasons.

methods.name: ReasonsMask intersect(ReasonsMask mask)
methods.comment:
* Intersects this mask with the given reasons mask.
     * 
     * @param mask The mask to intersect with.
     * @return The intersection of this and the given mask.

methods.name: boolean hasNewReasons(ReasonsMask mask)
methods.comment: * Returns true if the passed reasons mask has new reasons. * * @param mask The reasons mask which should be tested for new reasons. * @return true if the passed reasons mask has new reasons.

methods.name: int getReasons()
methods.comment:
* Returns the reasons in this mask.
     * 
     * @return Returns the reasons.
